title: Existing await-prefix preservation
requirement: WHEN existing Core/2 typed-await behavior is lowered to the universal machine, the adapter SHALL preserve its successful-prefix effects, duties and checkpoint atomicity.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Await after partial payment
scenarios.when: The preceding successful prefix reaches a typed await.
scenarios.then: Its committed prefix and residual duty remain the same as Core/2; exact universal Commit/Yield/Await opcodes remain an open design choice.
scenarios.blocker: needs a Core/2 typed-await to universal-machine lowering adapter with prefix/duty comparison
